name: Export NetPBM (savepnm)
description:
Saves current image under the form of a NetPBM file format with 16-bit per channel.

The extension of the output will be filename .ppm for RGB image and filename .pgm for gray-level image

Uses fixed input references and writes only invocation-owned outputs. Optional argument values are sent only when their use_* control is true; zero is preserved.
